falseCertificationPrevention.details: Outer CANCELLED status strictly overrides inner snapshot status (including SUCCESS), ensuring terminal CANCELLED state and avoiding false certification. Does not fabricate verification fields; isMathClean defaults to null and portalValidationStatus to PENDING.

retainedStatusEvidenceReason.details: Preserves error envelope reason object, explicit falsy error values via nullish coalescing, and hoists traceId, evidenceLogPath, evidenceHealth from payload.error.data.

ordinaryErrorsHandlingPreserved.details: Non-CANCELLED error envelopes (ERROR, UNKNOWN, lowercase cancelled, undefined) fall through to standard error handler returning { status: "ERROR", error: ... }.

dataEnvelopePrecedence.details: If payload.data is truthy, the normal data envelope remains authoritative even if accompanied by an error envelope.

environmentScope.details: Tests were verified against focused.stdout.log demonstrating 19 passing tests in a headless Node/Vitest VM environment; not evaluated against live browser DOM or SSE stream.
